_comment: Polar SKU → entitlement map. COPY this to keys/polar_map.json on the host and fill
in your real Polar price/product ids and your product UUID(s). keys/ is gitignored,
so the live map is never committed. Match is by price id first, then product id.
features: core = desktop install seats (usually 1); search/workflow = the detached
CLIENT seats layered on top of core. term: 'sub' (expires with the billing period)
